2610.10630.title: Phase-HDC: Replacing Optimizer History with Gradient Thresholds in Discrete Phase Learning
2610.10630.paper_summary: Training a compact model often needs far more memory than storing it, because the optimizer keeps its own records of past gradients. For a hyperdimensional classifier whose learned parameters are low-bit angles, which we call a \emph{phase memory}, these records take several times more memory than the model itself. We ask whether such a model can be trained while storing nothing but the model. The proposed method, Phase-HDC, turns each stored angle by at most one step per update, against the sign of its current gradient, and only when that gradient is large enough. We show that this simple rule is the exact solution of a first-order loss model in which every changed parameter pays a fixed cost. When everything except the update rule is held fixed, Phase-HDC matches the accuracy of Adam with 6-bit moments while storing three times less. Across eleven image, tabular, and text datasets, it stores 16--23$\times$ less than standard float32 Adam and 4--6$\times$ less than 8-bit Adam. The price is an average loss of about five accuracy points against float32 Adam, while Phase-HDC is more accurate than 8-bit Adam on six of the eleven datasets, including byte-level text prediction, where 8-bit Adam collapses. Instrumented training runs explain these outcomes. Once parameters must sit on a discrete grid, Adam's moments mainly decide whether a parameter moves at all, a decision that a threshold on the current gradient can make without memory, and coarse quantization of the moments breaks this decision for inputs that the data rarely contain. The storage savings are logical state rather than measured hardware memory.
2610.10630.paper_summary_zh: 訓練一個緊湊模型通常需要比存儲它更多的記憶體，因為優化器會保留過去梯度的記錄。對於一個學習參數為低位角度的超維分類器，我們稱之為\emph{相位記憶}，這些記錄佔用的記憶體是模型本身的幾倍。我們詢問是否可以在只存儲模型的情況下訓練這樣的模型。所提出的方法，Phase-HDC，在每次更新時最多將每個存儲的角度改變一步，根據其當前梯度的符號，並且僅在該梯度足夠大的時候進行。我們表明這一簡單規則是第一階損失模型的精確解，其中每個改變的參數都需支付固定成本。當除了更新規則以外的所有內容保持不變時，Phase-HDC的準確度與使用6位元瞬時數的Adam相匹配，同時存儲的記憶體少了三倍。在十一個圖像、表格和文本數據集上，它的存儲量比標準的float32 Adam少16--23$\times$，比8位元Adam少4--6$\times$。代價是相對於float32 Adam的平均損失約為五個準確度點，而Phase-HDC在十一個數據集中的六個上比8位元Adam更準確，包括字節級文本預測，在此情況下8位元Adam崩潰。儀器化的訓練運行解釋了這些結果。一旦參數必須位於離散網格上，Adam的瞬時數主要決定參數是否移動，這一決策可以在沒有記憶體的情況下由當前梯度的閾值做出，而瞬時數的粗量化會破壞這一決策，對於數據中很少包含的輸入。存儲的節省是邏輯狀態，而不是測量的硬體記憶體。
